claims.text: The model is compared against several state-of-the-art models including NBOW, PV, MT-RNN, MT-CNN, MT-DNN, and GRNN.
The model achieves competitive or better performance compared to state-of-the-art models on most tasks.
MT-RNN slightly outperforms the model on the SST dataset due to the nature of the data.
